subject: PO formatting, weekly invoicing & milestone discount triggers
messages:
From: Peter Lang <peter.lang@acmeenergy.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@acmeenergy.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Hi Neha,

We're getting the internal PO finalized and I wanted to confirm Redwood's ability to accommodate two procurement constraints before I route the PO:

1) Invoice cadence: Acme prefers a weekly consolidated invoice per vendor (all projects combined) — can Redwood issue weekly invoices rather than monthly?
2) Net terms: Our default is net60 for vendors of this tier. Is net60 possible (or net45 as a fallback)?
3) Discount triggers: We need any milestone or volume discounts to be applied only after formal acceptance/sign-off of the milestone deliverable (PO line must reference milestone ID).
4) PO formatting: Our AP team requires the PO number on each invoice, plus line-item SKU mapping to the line in the PO (we'll attach our PO template).

Can you confirm whether these are workable and outline any exceptions (minimum invoice amounts, required paperwork, or timing for discount application)?

Attaching: PO_Template_Acme_12345.pdf

Thanks — Peter
Peter Lang
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Energy

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Hi Peter — thanks for the note and the template. Short answers up front: we can support weekly invoicing and PO line-item mapping; net60 is possible subject to a brief finance review; discounts tied to milestone acceptance are doable with the right acceptance criteria in the SOW.

Details and next steps:
- Weekly invoices: We can produce consolidated weekly invoices per vendor. Finance requires a minimum invoice USD amount of $5,000 per invoice unless we agree to waive it for the contract (see below).
- Net terms: Standard is net30. Net60 can be approved by Finance for enterprise commitments (annual or minimum quarterly commit) after credit review — I'll loop in Vivek to advise on thresholds and the documentation we need.
- Discount triggers: We can configure discounts to only apply once a milestone is marked accepted in the project tracker and acceptance sign-off is attached to the invoice. We'll need milestone IDs in the PO line description so the invoice posting can tie back to the PO.
- PO formatting: Your attached template looks fine. We will include the PO number on each invoice and include the SKU -> PO line mapping in the invoice detail.

I've attached a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf) that includes milestone IDs and acceptance language. Vivek — can you confirm finance's requirements for net60 and any minimum invoice thresholds or paperwork (credit app/ACH mandate)?

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Neha — two quick clarifications from Procurement after reviewing the SOW:

- Acceptance timing: Our program approves milestone acceptance within 5 business days of deliverable submission. If Redwood needs more time to validate, we can add a 7-business-day dispute window, but discounts must not be paid until acceptance is complete.
- Proration: If services start mid-week, we will accept prorated first invoice.

We'll proceed with the PO once we have written confirmation of minimum invoice waiver (if possible) and a finance contact for the net60 approval. I'll upload the PO and route it once we have that.

Best,
Peter

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Peter Lang <peter.lang@acmeenergy.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Hi Peter — Vivek from Finance here. Appreciate the details. We can support the requested model with the following caveats and instructions: 

1) Net60: Approvable for enterprise customers on annual or committed ARR >= $250k, or with a credit application and approved credit line. If you expect lower ARR, we can offer net45 as a standard compromise. Please let Neha know expected annual run rate so we can scope the review.

2) Weekly consolidated invoices: Accepted in writing. To operationalize this we need:
   - PO number on each invoice header (your template covers this)
   - Line-item SKU -> PO line mapping in the invoice body (we will mirror your PO line IDs)
   - Billing contact + AP email to be included in the PO (procure@acmeenergy.com is fine)
   - Minimum invoice value: We typically require $5,000 min per invoice. For weekly billing with a short pilot, we can waive the minimum for the first 4 weeks. After that, invoices under $5k will be deferred to the next invoice unless a waiver is granted in writing.

3) Discount triggers & milestone acceptance: We will apply discounts only after the acceptance sign-off is attached to the invoice. For automated processing, please put the milestone acceptance reference (e.g., MILE-001) in the invoice line notes and attach the signed acceptance PDF.

4) Documentation & execution:
   - Required: Signed MSA + SOW (Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf) and vendor setup form.
   - Preferred: ACH/Bank details on file for faster payments.
   - We'll provision a DocuSign envelope for the MSA once the PO is routed.

Link to sample invoice and vendor setup checklist: https://drive.redwood.ai/invoices/sample-invoice-acme (internal)

If that aligns, Neha can confirm the deal ARR and I'll start the net60 review. Marissa — can you prepare the invoice waiver language for the first 4 weeks and add to the commercial doc?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
